name: HiddenCry
statement: Findings, written down after the fix.
summary: I research security flaws in open-source web applications and publish them once maintainers have a patch, or once the agreed disclosure window has closed. This site is the public record: the CVE, the affected versions, the weakness, and the remediation.

content.value: A record appears here only after the maintainer has had a private report and a real chance to ship a fix. The public page is the last step.

The work so far sits in application code that trusts the wrong boundary: a formula passed to eval, a session that outlives the account, a token left behind when a user is disabled, a password stored with a broken hash.

Each CVE keeps the original markdown notes in the repository and a typed article for the site. Screenshots stay next to the write-up. Proofs are the ones already published with the coordinated disclosure.
